title: Prime Minister's Office (Smart Nation and Digital Government Group)
what_it_is: Prime Minister's Office (Smart Nation and Digital Government Group)

sections.label: Digital Government Blueprint 2023
sections.summary: All Government services will be digital from end-to-end by 2023, as committed in the Digital Government Blueprint.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: All Government services will be digital from end-to-end by 2023, as committed in the Digital Government Blueprint.

sections.label: PayNow registrations and ICT contracts
sections.summary: PayNow registrations, projected Government ICT contract value and SME procurement participation are stated.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: For instance, there are now over 2.4 million individuals registered for PayNow Mobile, 1.7 million for PayNow NRIC and 200,000 companies for PayNow Corporate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The value of Government ICT contracts is projected to increase by over 30% for FY20, to $3.5 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) will be able to participate in up to 80% of procurement opportunities.

sections.label: Digital inclusion for vulnerable groups
sections.summary: The Government will strengthen and start digital inclusion efforts, including translating services and working with SG Digital Office.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: COVID-19 has shown that vulnerable groups who are unable to access digital technology are at a greater risk of being left behind.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The Government will take the lead to strengthen existing, and start new, digital inclusion efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: These include efforts to translate digital services and websites commonly used by seniors into our official languages.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Our digital services are tested for accessibility and meet accessibility standards, and we will constantly incorporate feedback from seniors and persons with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will also work closely with MCI’s SG Digital Office to increase outreach to less digitally literate persons and equip them with the necessary hardware and skills.
